For a model built over a strict subset of the network snapshots, `solve_model` calls `_call_extra_functionality` with `n.snapshots`, not the model’s stored snapshots. Under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, `_as_model_snapshots` returns that full network index unchanged, so the callback receives snapshots beyond those the model was built over.
